summary: Our project is about orbital debris, also known as space junk. Orbital debris( is any human-made object left in Earth orbit that no longer serves a purpose), and it is a growing problem for space activities. We built a website with information from NASA on this topic, along with an AI assistant, Najm, that answers users’ questions. We also propose two solutions, each with its steps: the first is lasers, and the second is smart robots with nets.
